start.content: The council met by night. We needed testimony before dawn. The witnesses contradicted one another, yet the pressure to secure a verdict only grew stronger.

choices.text: What charge did you finally use?

lawful.content: Lawful? In calmer times perhaps not. But this Passover is tinder. If we delay, the crowd hardens around Him and Rome intervenes. We judged necessity above procedure.

choices.text: So you rushed an illegal hearing.

charge.content: He was silent through much of the testimony. Then under oath He spoke of the Son of Man seated at power. I tore my robe and declared blasphemy. The council followed.

pressure.content: Yes, the courtyard fire burned through the night. Rooster cries, frightened disciples, conflicting witnesses inside — all of it converged. By sunrise we had our charge.

choices.text: You had a verdict, not truth.

closing.content: Call it what you wish. The midnight tribunal delivered Him to Pilate, and once Rome took custody, the matter left these chambers.
